tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background behind panels and lists.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panel, sheet, card and input background.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on ground or surface. 16.9:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: routes, sub-lines, captions. 6.1:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink-passed
tokens.usage: Stops and times the train has already passed. 4.9:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink-on-dark
tokens.usage: Text on sabz-900 or sabz-700.

tokens.name: ink-on-dark-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on sabz-900. 11.6:1.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Control borders and dividers between cards.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Row dividers inside a list or timeline.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: 2px timetable rule under section headers and above the sheet.

tokens.name: sabz-700
tokens.usage: Primary: Pakistan green. Primary buttons, active controls, key-panel borders, route done on the map.

tokens.name: sabz-800
tokens.usage: Primary pressed and hover.

tokens.name: sabz-900
tokens.usage: Dark surfaces: train number badge, your-stop row.

tokens.name: sabz-100
tokens.usage: Green tint: on-time status background, progress track.

tokens.name: zard-500
tokens.usage: Yellow accent: the train marker, the badge number, highlights on sabz-900. Never as text on white.

tokens.name: zard-100
tokens.usage: Next-stop row background.

tokens.name: status-ontime-bg
tokens.usage: On time (up to 15 min late) background.

tokens.name: status-ontime-fg
tokens.usage: On time text. 9.7:1 on its background.

tokens.name: status-late-bg
tokens.usage: Late (more than 15 min) background: a solid red block, darker than on time so they differ in lightness.

tokens.name: status-late-fg
tokens.usage: Late text. 5.0:1 on its background.

tokens.name: status-early-bg
tokens.usage: Early background.

tokens.name: status-early-fg
tokens.usage: Early text. 8.0:1 on its background.

tokens.name: status-nogps-bg
tokens.usage: No live GPS / timetable only background.

tokens.name: status-nogps-fg
tokens.usage: No live GPS text. 6.6:1 on its background.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 3px keyboard focus ring on every control.

tokens.name: map-land
tokens.usage: Map land fill.

tokens.name: map-water
tokens.usage: Rivers and sea.

tokens.name: map-border
tokens.usage: Province and country borders, dashed.

tokens.name: map-rail
tokens.usage: Rail lines with no train selected.

tokens.name: map-station
tokens.usage: Small station dots.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page title: train or station name.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Station and train names in lists.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section headers, status chips, buttons. Uppercase in English only.

styles.name: time-sm
styles.usage: Countdowns, scheduled times under expected ones.

styles.name: urdu-title
styles.usage: Page title in Urdu. Nastaliq needs line-height 2 or more.

styles.name: urdu-body
styles.usage: Names and running text in Urdu.

styles.name: urdu-label
styles.usage: Replaces the condensed uppercase label in Urdu: no capitals, one size up.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a dot and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and between cards in a list.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between a badge and its text; card padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Sidebar side gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space above the first section on desktop.

tokens.name: tap
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, small controls, status blocks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, buttons, inputs, the badge, rows.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of the phone panel only.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: The panel handle and map dots.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Controls and labels floating over the map, so they stay legible on any base map. Nothing else casts a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: The phone panel's edge over the map.

tokens.name: border-thin
tokens.usage: Row dividers.

tokens.name: border-key
tokens.usage: Control borders and key panels (sabz-700).

tokens.name: border-rule
tokens.usage: Timetable rules (rule).
